optimizedDescription.value: Run trusted graph indexing in lock-owning child process with validated IPC, signal-safe lease cleanup, crash containment, and typed failures.

optimizedContext.value:
# Isolated Index Worker
## Rules
- Public `runIsolatedGraphIndex` accepts storage root, trusted installed task-module URL/absolute path, JSON-serializable input, optional progress callback; resolves serializable result. Never renders, interprets CLI formats, mutates host exit state, or calls `process.exit()`.
- Acquire shared root-scoped index lock before fork; same-root concurrency fails typed busy before second child. Supervisor owns lease for full child lifetime and releases exactly once after success, task failure, creation/IPC/send failure, invalid/duplicate terminal IPC, early/non-zero/signal exit, or native crash.
- Startup failure is bounded even without `exit`: detach owned listeners, tear down IPC, best-effort terminate, release once, reject typed startup failure. Lock acquire/release/path/assertion internals; callers never handle tokens.
- Production uses `node:child_process.fork` with package-shipped worker containing task, parsers, native provider/store work. Child native crash cannot terminate host. Success requires terminal result, task cleanup, then exit 0; post-result crash/signal remains failure. No `process.exit()` masking. Tests may inject launcher/protocol seam; no production worker-thread/in-process mode.
- Worker imports exactly host-selected trusted module; async entrypoint receives serializable input + progress emitter, returns one serializable result or throws once. Missing/non-callable entrypoint or non-serializable input/progress/result => typed task/protocol failure. Module choice never end-user CLI input; not untrusted-code sandbox.
- Runtime-validated tagged IPC: zero-or-more progress then exactly one terminal result/failure. Malformed/unsupported/late/duplicate/missing terminal => protocol failure. Never double-settle, signal, or release. Raw envelopes/bootstrap commands internal.
- Forward valid progress unchanged and ordered; callback absence changes nothing. Child/supervisor emit no CLI text/JSON/TOON presentation; hosts render.
- Typed `SpecdCodeGraphError` subclasses with stable upper-snake-case codes distinguish busy, fork/IPC startup, invalid module/contract, task failure, malformed/unsupported/late/duplicate IPC, abnormal/early exit, signal termination; actionable messages and structured exit/signal details, no stderr parsing.
- During activity install parent `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM` handlers, forward same signal, await child, clean, reject typed signal failure. Remove only installed handlers; never exit/re-signal host.
- Lease-holding process releases on process exit; on Windows also `SIGBREAK`; retain `SIGTERM` release where delivered. Missing `SIGTERM` delivery cannot leave lease after process exit.
- Child receives internal code-graph-owned indication supervisor owns lock; provider skips reacquisition only for matching child/root. No public caller token or unrelated root/process bypass.
- Build stable ESM worker under published `dist/`; resolve relative to installed package. Verify public supervisor forks publish-shaped worker/task; built integration forces project index, receives terminal result, finishes cleanup, exits 0.
- Listener removal, child cleanup, IPC teardown, lock release idempotent and complete before promise settlement. Remove only owned listeners; leave no lock file/live child/open IPC.
## Constraints
- Child process mandatory for native-crash containment.
- No queueing, waiting, retry, stale-lock PID recovery, scheduling, background indexing.
- No `@specd/sdk`, `@specd/cli`, Commander, delivery formatter dependency.
- Inputs/progress/results/IPC JSON-serializable and runtime-validated at boundary.
- Direct lock helpers/raw IPC DTOs internal.
